arguments.sql:
SELECT
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(QUOTE(gender)) FROM main.gender) AS gender_labels,
    COUNT(*) AS hero_count,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(h.weight_kg) AS null_weights,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN h.weight_kg <= 0 THEN 1 END) AS nonpositive_weights,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(h.weight_kg) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null') THEN 1 END) AS nonnumeric_weights,
    MIN(h.weight_kg) AS minimum_weight,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS unmatched_races,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.race = '-' THEN 1 END) AS dash_races,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.race = '-' AND g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 END) AS female_dash_races
FROM main.superhero AS h
LEFT JOIN main.race AS r ON r.id = h.race_id
LEFT JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = h.gender_id;

arguments.sql:
WITH female_races AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.race_id
    FROM main.superhero AS h
    JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = h.gender_id
    WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN 'unmatched race'
         WHEN f.race_id IS NULL THEN 'race with no female heroes'
         ELSE 'race with female heroes' END AS population,
    COUNT(*) AS heroes,
    SUM(h.weight_kg IS NULL) AS null_weights,
    SUM(h.weight_kg IS 0) AS zero_weights,
    SUM(h.weight_kg IS 0 AND h.height_cm IS 0) AS zero_weight_and_height,
    SUM(h.weight_kg IS 0 AND h.height_cm > 0) AS zero_weight_positive_height,
    SUBSTR(GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN h.weight_kg IS 0 THEN h.superhero_name END, ', '), 1, 450) AS zero_weight_examples
FROM main.superhero AS h
LEFT JOIN main.race AS r ON r.id = h.race_id
LEFT JOIN female_races AS f ON f.race_id = r.id
GROUP BY population;

    COUNT(CASE WHEN height_cm > 0 THEN 1 END) AS positive_heights
FROM main.superhero
GROUP BY weight_status;
